# Short #007 - Time Travel #1: The Last Flight of the Hindenburg

## Title
I Had 3 Hours to Save the Hindenburg | Time Travel #1

## Description
May 6, 1937. The Hindenburg, almost as long as the Titanic and lifted by hydrogen, comes in to land at Lakehurst, New Jersey after storms kept it circling for hours. At 7:25 p.m. fire appears near the tail. In roughly half a minute the ship is destroyed. 62 of the 97 people aboard survive; 36 people die. The era of passenger airships ends with it.

A time-travel dramatization: the visit is fiction, the history is real. Visuals are AI-generated, not real footage.
